Find the missing entries in the following table:

| Sentence | Symbolic Form |
| --- | --- |
| Whenever $A,$ then $B$ | {{field-1}} |
| $A$ whenever $B$ | {{field-2}} |
| $A,$ provided that $B$ | {{field-3}} |

current_example.problem:
Consider the following predicates:

$\qquad$ $P(x):$ $x\in\mathbb {Z}^{-}$ $\qquad$ $Q(x):$ $x$ is negative

Which of the following expresses the conditional predicate $P(x) \Rightarrow Q(x)?$

I. Whenever $x$ is negative, then $x\in\mathbb {Z}^{-}$

II. $x$ is negative whenever $x\in\mathbb {Z}^{-}$

III. $x$ is negative, provided that $x\in\mathbb {Z}^{-}$
current_example.worked_solution:
Given that the implication $P \Rightarrow Q$ is true, we have the following:

- Whenever $P,$ then $Q$

- $Q$ whenever $P$

- $Q,$ provided that $P$

With that in mind, let's examine the given options.

- Option I reads
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14272126/assets/f2e6bfd2bb59c4af3e96017783876163f8d2d4e426c9e1a1d685f8b6285d12cd.svg)
which corresponds to $Q(x) \Rightarrow P(x).$ $\:{\color{red}\times}$

- Option II reads
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14272126/assets/610be261146f14602bf2ba009ba289abf3b7ab1bae10c4905acd770273ef3646.svg)
which corresponds to $P(x) \Rightarrow Q(x).$ $\:{\color{green}\checkmark}$

- Option III reads
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14272126/assets/8512a2a56c7dd5757626b9255c24b732b139e1c22a6881f422c6dabed807ecea.svg)
which corresponds to $P(x) \Rightarrow Q(x).$ $\:{\color{green}\checkmark}$

Therefore, the correct answer is "II and III only."
